rationale: Shift from glucose-limited to amino acid fermentation using abundant amino acids (alanine, serine, proline, arginine, cysteine) plus arabinose. Stickland-type reactions yield acetate, butyrate, CO₂, and H₂. Carbon budget: 42 mmol in, 13.6 for growth, 28.4 for products. Nitrogen: 8 mmol supports 0.40 /h growth (8/10 limiting). Modest growth rate avoids product inhibition seen in prior turns.
